spec.why: Owner approved the completed docs-root-migration loop, but its spec remains active; analyze approval, decision resolution, closure, UI and skill handoff seams.

requirements.text: Owner decision acceptance gates the whole plan before start and each task against its required accepted decisions.
Expose explicit human decision acceptance/rejection through CLI and browser admission with revision checks.
An explicit owner completion act records complete/delivered only after evidenced tasks and current independent PACK PASS.
Expose distinct pending question, decision, start, implementation, review, closure and delivered handoffs.
Align shipped and installed analyze/plan/implement/review skills with the owner gates.
Connect requirement, brief, spec, design/plan and task artifacts; gate spec questions separately from design decisions.
Require separate human start permission bound to the exact canonical plan scope; invalidate it on semantic plan amendments.
Run all approved tasks sequentially with actual evidence, stop on a new gate/failure, then request independent red-foreman review.
Version gated work so old engines refuse it while legacy golden witnesses remain byte-identical.

stories.want: a brief/spec/design/task flow with decision acceptance and separate start permission before the agent runs all planned tasks and independent review
stories.so: owner consent controls execution and the final recorded delivery state is truthful

out_of_scope: Implementation before owner decision and exact-plan start approval
Closing or rolling back the prior documentation initiatives
Generic job scheduling or speculative parallel execution

design.approach: Proposed owner flow from Q1: brief, spec question ceremony, design decision barrier, exact-plan start, approved sequential tasks, independent review and explicit owner finish. See design.md and plan.md; no implementation consent is inferred.

decisions.decision: Approve whole-plan design decisions before start, retaining per-task decision dependencies for rejected choices
decisions.because: Owner Q1 specifies a design approval barrier. Original scoped-only proposal is preserved in pre-plan-revision-4.json; this is an unaccepted planning refinement.

decisions.decision: Expose a separate Finish spec act through evidence-gated human closure after current independent PACK PASS
decisions.because: Owner flow names implementation and independent review but does not choose the final closure label or actor. Explicit finish is a concrete proposal, not inferred consent.

decisions.decision: Introduce opt-in specpack/0.4 for owner-gated work; preserve legacy bytes and adopt active legacy packs only through an owner act
decisions.because: Old engines refuse unknown formats instead of silently bypassing new fields; legacy corpus witnesses and the original schema remain unchanged.

decisions.decision: Store separate scope-bound start receipts, serialize mutations and atomically persist owner acts before recoverable audit append
decisions.because: Generic approval is not execution consent; semantic scope changes revoke permission. Atomic authoritative pack receipts avoid lost or repeated owner acts on journal failure.
